title: Say Ugip ed Panaon
intro: Isipen pa so panaon sanen say katuaan so inmepas tan saray mananisia so inanap. Pinili na sakey a melag a grupo so onatras nen say onsuko, a mananap na salimbengan ed saray ag-iilaloan a pasen — sakey a pasen a magmaliw a pampainawaan da ed loob na dakel a siglo ya agnabilang. Nen binmangon ira, say mundo so anguman ed kaliberliber da. Siopa irayan naugip a kamarerwa?
clues: Kalangweran kamin manaayam ed sakey a syudad nensaman.
Kinerew na komunidad mi ya kaiba mi ran mandayew, balet ag mi labay.
Tinaynan mi so syudad pian mananap na salimbengan ed saramay onsusumpa ed papanisiaan mi.
Sakey a matoor ya apatiran sali a kaiba so nanayam ed lolooban na panagamotan mi.
Pinaugip kami nen Allah ed loob na talon lasus tan siam a taon.
Nen binmangon kami la, say syudad mi ya datin mamapasegsegang et angawat na pananisia.

identity.label: Siopa Sikatayo?
options: Ashab al-Kahf (Saray Totoo ed Ungib)
Ashab al-Fil (Say Armada na Elepante)
Ashab al-Ukhdud (Saray Kaiba ed Kanal)
Saray Hawariyyun (Babangatan nen Isa)
Yajuj wa Majuj (Gog tan Magog)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Inmarawi kami ed sakey ya ungib tan nanaugip kami ed loob na nilasus a taon
Nilaban kami ed mandarlang ya apoy
Inakmon kami na baleg a sira
Sinubok kami ed sakey a mamilagron kabatyan a kamelyo
Naikdan kami na siamiran malinew a tanda
trial.answer: Inmarawi kami ed sakey ya ungib tan nanaugip kami ed loob na nilasus a taon

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Aralem ya ungib ed kapalandeyan
Sakey a baloto ed dayat
Sakey ya atagey ya istruktura ya onsabi ed tawen
Sakey a hardin ya inapag na duaran manbabakal
Sakey a babeng a balatyang tan gansa

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Binmangon kami tan aromog min say syudad mi et nagmaliw lan pananisia
Say mandarlang ya apoy so nagmaliw ya ambetel tan mareen
Sakey ya armada na kalaban so nalner ed dayat
Saray manok ya mangaawit na bato so aneral ed kalaban
Sakey a baleg a sira so angibulos ed sikami ed gilig na dayat
outcome.answer: Binmangon kami tan anengneng min say syudad mi et nagmaliw lan pananisia

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
